description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to secret references and secret configuration management in a software project.

methods.name: isValidEnvSecretRefId
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid environment secret reference ID based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: isSecretRef
methods.description: Determines if a given value conforms to the SecretRef type structure.

methods.name: parseEnvTemplateSecretRef
methods.description: Parses a string template to produce a SecretRef with source 'env' if it matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: coerceSecretRef
methods.description: Converts a value into a SecretRef, applying defaults and handling legacy formats.

methods.name: hasConfiguredSecretInput
methods.description: Checks if a value is a valid secret input, either as a string or a SecretRef.

methods.name: normalizeSecretInputString
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a string secret input, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: assertSecretInputResolved
methods.description: Ensures a secret input reference is resolved, throwing an error if unresolved.

methods.name: normalizeResolvedSecretInputString
methods.description: Normalizes a secret input string or asserts resolution if invalid.

methods.name: resolveSecretInputRef
methods.description: Resolves a secret input value and reference into explicit, inline, or combined SecretRef objects.
